title: Nearby Almost Duplicate
prompt:
Implement `contains_nearby_almost_duplicate(nums, index_gap, value_gap) -> bool`. Return `True` exactly when distinct indices `i` and `j` satisfy both `abs(i - j) <= index_gap` and `abs(nums[i] - nums[j]) <= value_gap`.

`nums` contains integers and both gaps are nonnegative integers. An index gap of zero cannot admit two distinct positions. Handle negative values and a value gap of zero correctly.

Aim for expected O(n) time and O(min(n, index_gap)) space with a sliding window and buckets of width `value_gap + 1`. A bucket collision is sufficient, but neighboring buckets still need an explicit value-difference check. Expire the element that is just outside the allowed index window before checking the current value.

example.reasoning: The last two values are one index apart and differ by two.
